name: helpdesk
description: Sistema web de gestión de tickets / Help Desk para soporte técnico

scripts.services:dev: concurrently -n identity,organization,catalog,ticketing,attachment,notification,audit,reporting,settings -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white,red,blackBright,blueBright "npm run dev -w services/identity-service" "npm run dev -w services/organization-service" "npm run dev -w services/catalog-service" "npm run dev -w services/ticketing-service" "npm run dev -w services/attachment-service" "npm run dev -w services/notification-service" "npm run dev -w services/audit-service" "npm run dev -w services/reporting-service" "npm run dev -w services/settings-service"
scripts.db:generate: npm run db:generate -w services/identity-service && npm run db:generate -w services/organization-service && npm run db:generate -w services/catalog-service && npm run db:generate -w services/ticketing-service
scripts.db:push: npm run db:push -w services/identity-service && npm run db:push -w services/organization-service && npm run db:push -w services/catalog-service && npm run db:push -w services/ticketing-service
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed -w services/identity-service && npm run db:seed -w services/organization-service && npm run db:seed -w services/catalog-service
